description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Freezes the open round's numbers and keeps the best arms for the next round. A winner is recorded only when the readout says likely_winner, or when `pick` names an arm the user chose. Ask the user before passing `pick`.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/experiments/{id}/close-round.)
name: close_experiment_round
title: Close a test round
